title: MenuContent
description: Menu content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of dishes, each with a picture, the name, the weight or the portion, the price as it is shown, a line and an optional badge. One object is valid in every menu layout (cards in two, three or four columns, rows).

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.description: the dishes, in the order they are shown

id.description: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

image.description: address of the dish picture; none: the placeholder

title.description: the name of the dish (the alt text of the picture)

weight.description: the weight or the portion as it is shown; empty: none

price.description: the price as it is shown

description.description: one line about the dish; empty: none

badge.description: a short pill (new, spicy); empty: no badge
